title: At the bus stop
goal: Use compounds with case endings and owners: otobüs durağında, havalimanına, okul çantam, Ali'nin doğum günü.

intro.text: After a compound, a case ending takes an n: *otobüs durağında* (at the bus stop), *havalimanına* (to the airport). **My** replaces the `-(s)I`: *okul çantam* (my school bag), not *okul çantasım*.

exercises.question: How do you say **at the bus stop**?

why.1: After `-(s)I`, a case ending needs an n: *durağında*.
why.2: The compound keeps its `-(s)I`: *otobüs durağı*, then n and *-da*.
why.3: *Otobüsün* would be **the bus's**; a bus stop takes no genitive. And the n is missing.

exercises.en: We're going to the airport by taxi.

reject.why: *Havalimanı* ends in the `-ı` of a compound, so the dative takes n, not y: *havalimanına*.
After the `-ı` of a compound, add n before the case ending: *havalimanına*.

exercises.explain: *havalimanı* is a compound written as one word (*hava limanı*): n + *-a*.

exercises.prompt: I'm waiting at the bus stop.

reject.why: The compound keeps its `-(s)I`, then n and the case: *otobüs durağında*.
After `-(s)I`, the locative needs an n: *durağında*.

accept: My brother is studying at Ankara University.
My sister is studying at Ankara University.
My [brother|sister] is a student at Ankara University.

exercises.label: *okul çantası* (school bag) with an owner: my school bag, your school bag…
exercises.explain: The owner's possessive takes the place of the compound's `-sı`: *okul çanta-m*, *okul çanta-n*… Only the third person keeps *-sı*.

reject.why: A noun takes one possessive only: **my** replaces the `-(s)I`: *okul çantam*.

exercises.explain: *havalimanı* ends in the `-ı` of a compound, so n before the ablative *-dan*.

exercises.prompt: We're going to Ali's birthday party.

exercises.en: The child's book is on the table.
exercises.explain: A particular owner, **the child**, takes the genitive: *çocuğun kitabı*. *Çocuk kitabı* is a children's book.

exercises.en: The library is next to the post office.

accept: I go to the gym every morning.
Every morning I go to the gym.
I am going to the gym every morning.

exercises.prompt: We'll celebrate my mother's birthday on Sunday.
accept: Pazar günü annemin doğum gününü kutlayacağız.
Annemin doğum gününü pazar günü kutlayacağız.
Pazar günü annemin doğum gününü kutlarız.
Biz pazar günü annemin doğum gününü kutlayacağız.

reject.answer: Pazar günü annemin doğum günü kutlayacağız.
reject.why: **My mother's birthday** is a definite object: it takes the accusative, after an n: *doğum gününü*.
